5059574937835.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Hanging Cord
The hanging cord gives the ornament a defined attachment point for a suitable support. It allows the decorative face to remain visible and makes it easy to include the piece among other hanging accents in the intended display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Green. Quantity: 15 pack.
Set of 15 festive green baubles featuring a decorative detail design for Christmas tree decoration.
Each ornament includes a hanging cord, allowing easy attachment to branches and coordinated display.
Crafted from durable plastic material, these ornaments are designed to add colour and visual interest.
Versatile decorative accessory suitable for creating focal points within seasonal home arrangements.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering
Included: Hanging Cord
Hanger included

5059059060935.sourceDescription:
Finish your festive display with the Pelle & Sol Natural Wicker Christmas Tree Collar. Crafted from woven willow, this decorative tree base cover surrounds standard stands to help conceal exposed supports beneath many real and artificial Christmas trees. The structured wicker design offers a tidy alternative to a traditional fabric Christmas tree skirt, while its natural beige-brown finish adds warmth and texture to the room. Suitable for traditional, Scandinavian, farmhouse and contemporary Christmas schemes, it coordinates easily with lights, baubles, garlands and wrapped gifts. The strong woven construction is designed for repeated seasonal use. Position it around a stable tree stand, keep it dry and store carefully after Christmas so it is ready to reuse year after year.
Neater festive presentation: Surrounds the tree stand to conceal exposed supports and create a cleaner, more coordinated finish around the base of the Christmas tree.
Natural woven willow: Adds warm colour, organic texture and rustic character without overpowering the decorations, lights or wrapped presents around the tree.
Structured skirt alternative: Provides a defined decorative surround without the loose edges associated with a traditional fabric Christmas tree skirt.
Versatile festive styling: Complements traditional, Scandinavian, farmhouse, woodland, contemporary and neutral Christmas decorating schemes.
Real and artificial tree use: Suitable for positioning around many standard stands used with either real or artificial Christmas trees.
Reusable seasonal décor: Strong woven construction can be carefully stored after Christmas and brought out again for future festive displays.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

5056797099135.baseName: MySmartBuy 2 Pack Acrylic LED Mushrooms, 600 Micro LED Garden Lights
5056797099135.variantName: MySmartBuy 2 Pack Acrylic LED Mushrooms, 600 Micro LED Garden Lights
5056797099135.sourceDescription:
Add a touch of enchanted woodland magic to your festive decorating with this set of 2 light up mushrooms from MySmartBuy. The set includes one larger and one smaller mushroom, each with a domed cap and tapered stem formed from a glittering gold frame, wrapped in fine strands of warm white micro LEDs. With 600 warm white micro LEDs across the pair, the mushrooms glow with a rich, golden sparkle that looks magical after dark. Group them together on a sideboard, console table or beside the Christmas tree for a whimsical indoor display, or set them out in the garden among borders and along pathways to create a fairytale scene. Ground spikes are included for secure outdoor placement on lawns and in flower beds. The set is supplied with a 5m lead cable for plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer lights it for 6 hours and then switches it off for 18 hours, so it comes on at the same time every evening. A charming alternative to traditional Christmas figures, these mushrooms suit woodland, cottage and fairytale-themed displays and can be enjoyed right through the winter. At a glance: set of 2 mushrooms, one large and one small | gold glitter frames | 600 warm white micro LEDs | ground spikes included | 5m lead cable | 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer | indoor and outdoor display.
SET OF 2 MUSHROOMS – One large and one small, each with a domed cap and tapered stem on a glittering gold frame.
600 WARM WHITE MICRO LEDS – Fine light strands wrapped across both mushrooms for a rich, golden sparkle.
INDOORS OR OUT – Lovely beside the Christmas tree or on a sideboard, or in garden borders and along pathways.
GROUND SPIKES AND 5M LEAD – Secure outdoor placement, with plenty of reach from your socket.
AUTOMATIC TIMER – Built-in 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer, so they light up at the same time every evening.

Get your Christmas lights exactly where you want them with this low voltage extension cable from MySmartBuy. Designed to extend the reach of compatible low voltage lighting, it connects between the power supply and your lighting product to give you extra cable length. It is ideal for LED Christmas lights, outdoor figures and garden lighting, helping you reach further corners of the garden, the end of the drive or the top of a tree without moving your power supply. Simply connect it between your power supply and your lighting product to extend the cable run. Planning a festive display is much easier when you are not limited by the position of your sockets. An extension cable gives you the freedom to place lights and figures where they look best, whether that is the far side of the lawn, the top of a hedge or the end of the drive. A simple, practical addition that makes planning your festive display easier, season after season. EASY TO FIT : Connects between the power supply and the lighting product.
FLEXIBLE INSTALLATION : Extra cable length for easier positioning.
VERSATILE : Ideal for LED Christmas lights, outdoor decorations and garden lighting.
SEASONAL DISPLAYS : Helps you reach further spots in your festive display.

5056797097735.variantName: MySmartBuy Twinkling Micro LED Christmas Wreath Light, Warm White, Timer
5056797097735.sourceDescription:
Give your home a twinkling festive welcome with this pre-lit 2D wreath from MySmartBuy. Warm white micro LEDs on a sleek black wire frame are finished with a 10% twinkle effect, so the wreath shimmers softly all evening. Choose from 38cm with 480 LEDs, 50cm with 720 LEDs or 58cm with 960 LEDs. It arrives fully assembled with a hanging point, so it is ready to go straight onto a door, wall or window, and the sturdy storage box keeps it safe between seasons. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use. It is supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer takes care of switching it on and off, for effortless seasonal lighting. A lit wreath is the perfect finishing touch for the front of the house, giving visitors a warm welcome and making your home look instantly festive from the street. Pair it with matching lights along the porch or a garland around the door frame for a coordinated look. A beautiful way to welcome guests this Christmas, it can be brought out year after year to make your home look instantly festive. At a glance: 2D wreath with 10% twinkle | warm white micro LEDs | black wire frame | 38cm (480 LEDs), 50cm (720 LEDs) or 58cm (960 LEDs) | fully assembled with hanging point | storage box | 5m lead | timer | indoor and outdoor use.
TWINKLING 2D WREATH : Warm white micro LEDs with a 10% twinkle effect on a sleek black wire frame.
THREE SIZES : 38cm with 480 LEDs, 50cm with 720 LEDs or 58cm with 960 LEDs.
FULLY ASSEMBLED : Arrives ready to hang with a hanging point, plus a sturdy storage box for easy packing away.
5M LEAD CABLE : Supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket to your chosen spot.
INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE : Lovely on front doors, walls and windows.

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The gold finish and PVC construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: PVC. Colour: Gold. Stated size: 40 x 90 cm. Quantity: 4 pack.

Versatile 40 x 90 cm design allows flexible placement as a focal point on doors, walls, or within coordinated seasonal arrangements.
Easy to style and reposition, these wreaths add texture and festive detail to refresh your home display throughout the season.

5313817006635.sourceDescription:
Product Overview

 This festive pink Christmas tinsel garland comes pre-assembled with warm white clear wire LED lights and cute Santa & snowflake cutout decorations. 
 Powered by 3 AA batteries (batteries NOT included), it has two size options and supports steady-on & flashing lighting modes.

Specifications
Option 1: 3 m / 9.8 ft 30 Warm white LEDs 3AA battery box Steady on + FlashOption 2: 5.7 m / 18.7 ft 40 Warm white LEDs 3AA battery box Steady on + Flash

 Material: Soft pink PET tinsel, transparent wire with warm white LED, paper Santa & snowflake pendants
 Light color: Warm white (3000K)
 Power source: 3 × AA batteries (batteries excluded)
 Modes: Constant steady light & flashing twinkle, switch controlled by battery box
 Protection grade: IP44 (splash-proof, for indoor & covered outdoor use)
 Lifespan: 20000 hours

Application Scenarios
Christmas home decor, Xmas tree, front door arch, staircase railing, fireplace mantel, window frame, bedroom headboard, holiday party decoration, covered patio.
Notes

 Batteries are not included, please prepare 3 AA batteries before use.
 IP44 splash-proof: resistant to splashing water, do NOT submerge in water.
 Remove batteries when not in use for a long time to avoid battery leakage damage.
【Pink Christmas-Themed Design】Unlike traditional red and green Christmas lights, this string of lights features a fresh pink color scheme, paired with classic Santa Claus figures and whimsical snowflake accents for a soft and sweet style. Perfect as festive decor for your daughter’s bedroom, drape it over the windowsill or bed rail—the adorable color scheme will be a big hit with little ones, creating a sweet little Christmas nook.
【Total Length: 18.7 Feet & 40 LED Bulbs】This pink string light measures 18.7 feet in total length and features 40 evenly spaced LED bulbs, creating a perfectly balanced distribution of light. Whether draped around a Christmas tree, doorframe, or railing, a single strand of these pink lights can complete the decoration for a small area. There’s no need to connect multiple strands, resulting in a neater, more aesthetically pleasing look. The staggered lighting creates a more immersive Christmas atmosphere.
【2 Lighting Modes】This Christmas string light features two practical lighting modes—steady and flashing—with simple, intuitive operation. For a family Christmas Eve dinner or post-meal relaxation, turn on the steady, soft glow to create a quiet and soothing atmosphere; when friends and family gather or for a children’s Christmas party, switch to the flashing dynamic light effect to highlight the lively and joyful festive spirit. One string of lights meets a variety of mood needs.
【Battery-Powered】This pink garland is battery-powered, eliminating the need for electrical outlets or the hassle of long extension cords. Installation requires no special tools—simply wrap it around branches, door frames, railings, or window frames to secure it. Even beginners can set it up in just a few minutes. Taking it down and storing it after the holidays is just as easy; it folds flat to save space and can be reused next Christmas.
【Christmas-Themed Lighting】This Christmas tinsel garland is designed specifically for the holiday season. It can be wrapped around Christmas trees, front door frames, window frames, balcony railings, and stair handrails. It’s also perfect as a backdrop for Christmas parties, bedroom decor, and festive window displays—making it an excellent choice for creating that special Christmas atmosphere.
Guarantee - 1 month

5060381729735.sourceDescription:
EVRE Snow Flocked Spruce is a 5ft (150 cm) artificial Christmas tree with a snowy flocked finish, already decorated with pine cones and red berries, so it has a frosted winter look before you add a single bauble. The green of the branches still shows through the snow, and its 400 tips shape for a full, bushy look. Hinged branches drop into place as the two sections slot together, it suits smaller living rooms, bedrooms, offices and reception areas, and it comes apart after Christmas to store and use again.
5ft (150 cm) snow flocked Christmas tree, already decorated with pine cones and red berries for a frosted winter look straight out of the box.

Assembly: unfold the metal stand, slot in the base section, add the remaining section(s), then peel back and shape each branch. Allow up to 30 minutes for the fullest finish. Comes apart for storage at the end of the season and can be reused year after year.
Safety: keep away from fires, heaters and naked flames, use lights designed for Christmas trees, and supervise children and pets near the tree.
Available in 4ft 5ft 6ft 7ft and 8ft

5059442168835.variantName: Norway Spruce Real Fresh Cut Christmas Tree 5ft (150cm) · 本规格 / Selected: 5ft
5059442168835.sourceDescription:
The original Christmas tree, the Norway Spruce has been grown in the UK since Victorian times and is the variety most people picture at Christmas. Its classic conical shape, dark green foliage and fresh scent bring a traditional, nostalgic feel to your home, and its firm, slightly prickly needles are ideal for hanging decorations. Norway Spruce can drop needles if it dries out, so keeping it well watered is key. Our trees are grown in the UK and freshly cut before dispatch. When your tree arrives, cut a few centimetres from the base of the trunk and stand it in water straight away. Keep it in a stand with a water reservoir, topped up every 1-2 days, and away from radiators and fires so it stays fresh throughout Christmas.
